3 x 10 = 30 minutes of commercials
30 / 60 = 0.5 hours of commercials
1.5 - 0.5 = 1 hour of actual programming
One hour of content padded to ninety minutes is a forty-percent waste of Michael's evening, which is honestly better odds than most sitcoms.
\boxed{1}
